show.title: Off Season
show.tagline: Season One — All access. No excuses.

episodes.title: David Njoku
episodes.description: David Njoku lives with urgency and joy, balancing charity, Miami retreats, and scars from a fire accident. His mantra "No Tomorrow" reflects a life of resilience, purpose, and relentless drive.

episodes.title: Penei Sewell
episodes.description: Away from game day, Penei Sewell stays focused. Training continues, but fatherhood comes first. Between the weight room and time at home, his offseason is shaped by family, responsibility, and building a legacy that lasts beyond the field.

episodes.title: Trey Hendrickson
episodes.description: After his best season, Trey Hendrickson faces contract uncertainty. Through punishing drills, family, and raw honesty, "The Edge" shows a relentless man fueled by purpose, not approval.

episodes.title: George Kittle
episodes.description: Follow NFL star George Kittle through an offseason driven by obsession, discipline, and joy. From brutal training to quiet moments at home, this is the unseen work behind Sundays.

episodes.title: Ricky Pearsall
episodes.description: Ricky Pearsall rebuilds after a near-fatal shooting. From training to family talks, his comeback is driven by grit and faith-proving that this 49ers wide receiver was always meant to be here.
